reviews.outcome: No serious defect in the adopted dichotomy. The regular case is proved directly using small unions. Adjacent [CAICEDO-02](source-errors/findings/CAICEDO-02.json), false cofinality bound, and local [03](source-errors/findings/CAICEDO-03.json), domain slip. The remaining singular argument, stronger topological theorem and Jónsson material are not adopted or certified.
